# Keep tag visibility checks separate from tag selected-state checks

The deleted tag-checked helper read pressed state; accepted assert_tag_constraints_visible instead checks tag-bar visibility, child count excluding the mode widget and ordered qfb-tag- IDs. assert_tag_mode checks the mode value separately. Preserve those distinctions in test names and assertions rather than treating a visibility check as selected-state coverage. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/test/browser.
